parsed.claim: The bespoke predicate IsDegenerate is satisfiable: the empty graph on Fin 3 is 2-degenerate (and so IsTwoDegenerate holds for it). This shows the definition is not vacuously false.
parsed.lean:
theorem probe_nv : TwoDegenerateGraphs.IsDegenerate 2 (⊥ : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) := by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hs
  refine ⟨v, hv, ?_⟩
  simp [TwoDegenerateGraphs.neighborsWithin]
